mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REQUEST AS r JOIN USER AS u ON r.uidx = u.uidx JOIN BOOKS AS b ON r.bidx = b.bidx WHERE r.delyn = 'N'

SELECT b.coverImg, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, u.name, u.userNumber, r.rqidx, r.regDate, r.status, r.rejectionReason FROM REQUEST AS r JOIN USER AS u ON r.uidx = u.uidx JOIN BOOKS AS b ON r.bidx = b.bidx WHERE r.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY r.rqidx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};

SELECT b.coverImg, b.title, b.originalTitle, b.subtitle, b.author, b.publisher, b.publishedYear, b.isbn, b.totalPages, b.sizeWidth, b.sizeHeight, b.weight, b.category, b.introduction, b.price, u.name, u.userNumber, r.rqidx, r.status, DATE_FORMAT(r.regDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS regDate, r.rejectionReason FROM request r JOIN books b ON r.bidx = b.bidx JOIN `user` u ON r.uidx = u.uidx WHERE r.rqidx = #{rqidx} AND u.delyn = "N" AND b.delyn = "N" AND r.delyn = "N"
